# The marker allowlist. A folder listed here may hold a .protected-name-ok
# marker, and then its files may name the one system that its import adapter
# reads from (docs/decisions/0011-names-policy.md). A marker in any other
# folder fails the names check. One folder per line, from the repository root.
# The names check reads this file from the base branch.
